subject: Layout similar to RStudio: Several Panes with individual scrollbars that fill the total screen

messages.author: 7fbb1ca565764061
messages.subject: Layout similar to RStudio: Several Panes with individual scrollbars that fill the total screen
parts:
Hi,

does anybody has advice of how to create a layout for shiny that is similar to the RStudio layout? I would like to have up to 4 panes arranged in a grid with individual scrollbars for each pane. The total height and width of the pane grid should be fixed to 100% of the window size (browser window). Since the contents of each pane may be longer, I would like to have (vertical) scrollbars for the individual panes. Ideally, it would also be possible to resize the panes, like in RStudio, but fixed widths and heights would be a start.

I want to use this layout for a shiny based project that allows to solve interactive problem sets in R. To the left there shall be a Notebook pane with task descriptions and little editor fields where user can enter code (a bit similiar to an IPython notebook) and check the code. To the right there shall be other panes like a plot pane, an object explorer pane, or an exercise selection pane.

Cheers,
Sebastian
